lines.text: Rain starts on a grey street. @maya_front opens a yellow @umbrella_open and grins at the sky.
Slow push in; the yellow is the only colour.

writes.note: I tightened the action line and kept the order of events and both names.

reply.rationale: Trimmed filler words ("It starts to", "bright", "up") while keeping both @names, the sequence and the direction block last.
